A '''long-handled lightsaber''' was constructed by the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]]. Poof built this lightsaber, which he powered using a yellow [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]. Later in his life, he would use a sapphire crystal to power it.

==History==
Though a very skilled swordsman, Master Poof rarely needed to brandish his weapon and fight, preferring negotiating and peaceful outcomes, much like fellow Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], [[Ashaar Khorda]] threatened to destroy one of the key Republic worlds using the [[Infant of Shaa]]. Poof used his long weapon to confront Khorda on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] but the Jedi Master died after being stabbed by Khorda.
